question: Is pol_diam (polhode L2 diameter) recoverable from the 28-dim LC feature set well enough to drive the s053 adaptive-bracket rule at inversion time?
hypothesis: pol_diam can be estimated from the LC alone, making the polhode prior an inversion architecture (not just a post-hoc explanation).
narrative_md: pol_diam is LC-recoverable at ~25% holdout MAPE on seeds 100-119 -- decision COARSE_USEFUL, inside the s053 adaptive-bracket tolerance (which tolerates ~2x pol_diam error). The |omega| sanity control reproduces s008's LOO MAPE within 0.65pp, confirming lib.lc_features is faithful. Top features (dmag_mean_abs, acf_lag1) are exactly the modulation-rate signatures polhode amplitude predicts. The polhode prior is operational, not just analytical. Supervised regression on truth pol_diam/|omega| labels, so it reads truth as input.
